finding.text: The Navigation page never shows up as a top tab. public/framework/core/Page/page.js:42 adds `navigation` to `children:`, but `bar()` (page.js ~line 99) still hard-codes `["overview","make","layout","generator","api","doc","files","old"]`. The tab strip in the Page sheet.png shows no NAVIGATION tab, and the Navigation sheet.png shows the page with no tab strip at all, filed in the sidebar after "Old". Add "navigation" to `bar()` after "layout".

Ask 2 is not in the diff. There is no public/framework/core/Page/layout/readme.md: no core concepts, no index of layout types, no decision process, nothing moved or linked. task.jsonl says it "waits on module-experts", so the task can't land yet.

Ask 7 is not in the diff either: public/framework/core/Page/readme.md is untouched, so the one-line-per-sub-system list (layout, navigation, making a page, storage, AI and sessions) doesn't exist. The core/Page/ai/ and core/Page/dynamic/ pages that task.jsonl added are also missing.
Ask 1 wanted ONE judged table (what, where, state, keep?). inventory/ holds only the three raw minion files (A, B, C) and a brief; no merged, Opus-judged table exists.

Twelve page.jsonl files under public/framework/ai/2026/09/25 and 09/28 carry `{"file":...}` / `{"gone":true}` lines that the live server appended. They have nothing to do with this task, and one points at a directory (`ai-2-rhythm-tabs-sections-and-sidebar-va/`). This is the exact sweep-in trap page-jsonl.md describes. Drop them from the merge.
public/framework/core/Page/doc/page-jsonl.md is not added to the `notes:` list in page.js:53, so the size doc (ask 6) can't be reached from the Page page's Docs tab. Add `page-jsonl` there.

navigation/page.js:58, :68 and :87 link to raw `.md` files (`/framework/core/Page/navigation/doc/prior-work.md`). The page is a plain `Page`, not a `Doc`, so those docs have no rendered route (breaks "route everything"). Also, :58 says prior-work.md holds the "kinds that scale want swap" finding, but that finding is in alternatives.md.

The navigation page has no doc/ route of its own, yet public/framework/core/Page/doc/navigation.md already exists as a note. Two different "navigation" pages sit one click apart. Merge the old note into the new page, or link one from the other.

navigation/page.js:36: the "Levels that stack" tile goes to /framework/core/Page/api/ instead of the section below it on the same page. The four "Core concepts" tiles all leave the page, which is odd for tiles that read as a table of contents. Anchor them to the four h2 sections.

Navigation sheet.png: the page is 599–717px wide, and 82% of the screen is empty at 3440. The alternatives table and the levels screenshot are the two wide things that would benefit from the room. The order is right (persistent-vs-switching first), and the text is long for a level-1 page; section 3's code block could move to doc/.
doc/page-jsonl.md:65 says "the CMS visit-log kind noted above", but nothing above mentions a visit log.

The Servex/pages.js create_page change is simple and sound: it reads the parent context before writing, requires `description`, and makes no empty doc/. Server/page-size.mjs is a clear report-only tool. The page and new-page skill edits are tight, and the documentation-skill line covers ask 5.
Ask 8 (a session id posted on the card for every agent) can't be checked from these files. Confirm the card lists who, what and session for all 13 agents in task.jsonl.

The ai2 figma sheets (e.g. …figma-sept-2026-1-typography/sheet.png) are cramped at 1280: "Heading One" breaks letter by letter, and the widest element is 3859px, so the page scrolls sideways. This predates the task and is only in the diff because of finding 5, but it is worth a separate card.
